candidates.name: 海岸汽车广告
candidates.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: candidate A for an AI film-production website landing page; standalone cinematic campaign photograph, ultra-wide 2.39:1 landscape, highest available resolution.
Primary request: An arresting, photorealistic location-photographed automotive campaign frame with the visual discipline and credibility of a premium international car commercial.
Scene: a rugged Atlantic coastal road just after a storm, blue hour before sunrise. Charcoal wet tarmac bends along a dark cliff; distant slate-blue sea and low cloud meet in a long quiet horizon. Restrained natural light, a faint warm break at the horizon.
Subject: one unbranded, believable contemporary silver grand-touring coupe, three-quarter rear view in the RIGHT half, modest in scale within the landscape, sculpted real metal reflecting a pale strip of sky, real tires contacting the road, lights subtle. Slight rain streaks and road grime, physically credible reflections, no futuristic concept-car exaggeration.
Composition: a 40mm anamorphic location frame at road height; strong depth and deliberate leading lines. The LEFT 35–40% remains naturally quiet dark cliff and open road for website white headline placement, but it is still a coherent photographed environment. No black overlay, no graphic split, no fake empty panel. Keep the principal car within the central-right safe area so modest panoramic cropping works.
Photographic direction: delicate silver body edge against near-black landscape, rich but readable shadows, silver/cold blue/peat tones, restrained filmic highlight rolloff, very fine 35mm film texture, subtle atmospheric perspective. The eye should feel weather, distance and physical scale. A real film still rather than an immaculate CGI car render.
Avoid: cosmetic bottles, product pedestals, stones as still-life props, neon cyan-magenta lighting, conspicuous lens flare, sun rays, fog machine look, over-sharpening, glossy AI smoothness, impossible roads, mirror-perfect symmetry, text, letters, logos, watermarks, borders, contact sheets. Deliver ONE finished photograph.

candidates.name: 雨夜运动广告
candidates.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: candidate B, standalone premium sports campaign film still for a video-creation website; ultra-wide 2.39:1 landscape, highest available resolution.
Primary request: A photorealistic, photographed athletic advertising frame with raw energy, purposeful motion blur and tangible urban rain. One evocative frame from a real sports commercial, with practical light and restrained grading.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet concrete running track under an overpass at night after rain. Honest rough concrete, faded lane marks, a long low overhead practical strip light and a distant single warm sodium street lamp. Mostly charcoal, muted gray-green and warm ivory, no sci-fi neon.
Subject: ONE adult female runner in the center-RIGHT, captured side-on during an actual powerful sprint stride, focused face, realistic athletic build, short tied hair, dark plum windbreaker, black running shorts, pale running shoes with NO visible logos. Realistic hands and anatomically plausible legs. Shoe kicks a small physically credible fan of water from a shallow puddle; fabric flutters subtly. Sweat and a few wet flyaway hairs, skin with natural texture. Not a fashion pose, not a fitness stock-photo smile.
Composition/framing: low camera tracking parallel, 50mm cinema lens, the subject is sharp at torso and face, small genuine motion smear on near limbs and background, NOT smeared anatomy. Low graphic pools of white practical light on wet ground. LEFT 35% is simple dark structural space with clear tonal separation for white website copy; no text, no artificial black panel, no overlay. Keep subject readable, striking and large enough for a landing page.
Lighting/mood: harder motivated side light sculpts the face and clothes; retained shadow detail, no impossible rim glow. The composition feels selected by an experienced cinematographer. Fine organic grain and gentle highlight halation, realistic dynamic range, zero airbrushed beauty finish. Understated, urgent, human, tactile.
Avoid: perfect mirrors, excessive splashing, floating runner, added people, multiple exposures, exaggerated muscles, dramatic smoke, neon cyan/magenta, generic orange-and-teal LUT, plastic skin, CGI, hyper-sharpened droplets, text, type, logos, watermarks, UI elements, collage. ONE finished photograph.

candidates.name: 匠人纪实肖像
candidates.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: candidate C, a cinematic documentary-brand-film still for a creative production landing page, ultra-wide 2.39:1 landscape, highest available resolution.
Primary request: An intimate, photorealistic editorial frame of a real ceramic artist working in a lived-in studio, photographed with the care of an independent feature film. Humanity, experience and quiet concentration rather than stock-photo polish.
Scene/backdrop: an old pottery workshop in Kyoto in late afternoon, worn timber shelves, a few simple unfinished clay bowls, plaster wall with genuine uneven texture, a broad side window out of frame. The room feels practical and specific, not decorated for a catalogue.
Subject: ONE Japanese woman in her early fifties, believable lived-in face, subtle crow's feet, individual skin pores, some gray in dark hair loosely tied back, faded indigo work shirt and linen apron. She sits at a pottery wheel in the RIGHT half, eyes lowered in concentration, naturally working the rim of one low wide clay bowl. Relaxed believable hands with damp clay on the fingers, no theatrical pose and no looking into camera. Only one bowl at the wheel.
Composition: medium-wide observational camera at seated eye level, 50mm cinema lens at a modest aperture with the workshop still legible. Her face and working hands make a quiet diagonal on the right, her torso and wheel remain within frame. LEFT third is quiet workshop shelving and soft shaded plaster, useful space for website copy while still being a real environment. No fake dark gradient or hard divide.
Lighting/mood: soft directional late afternoon window light, warm skin and chalky cream clay, muted indigo and rich tobacco-brown wood. Air is clear, no visible sunbeams or theatrical haze. Retain midtones and natural brightness: this frame should be WARMER AND LIGHTER than a moody automotive campaign. Gentle Kodak-like grain, nuanced skin colour, real small imperfections and calm unforced detail. A deeply believable captured moment, not a waxy photoreal render.
Avoid: flawless model face, smooth plastic skin, generic smiling influencer, excessive wrinkles, extreme bokeh, unreal orange teal grade, decorative rock slabs, symmetry, dozens of props, painterly look, 3D rendering, fake film scratches, text, lettering, logos, watermark, border, collage. Deliver ONE complete still photograph.

Subject: ONE beautifully proportioned, unbranded vintage-inspired rectangular wristwatch placed diagonally on a dark oxblood leather book cover in the RIGHT half. Brushed stainless steel rectangular case with polished beveled edges, slightly domed crystal, warm silver ivory dial, ONLY two slender dark hands at approximately 10:10 and twelve elegant simple baton hour markers, absolutely NO brand name or date complication. A dark chestnut calf-leather strap with stitching gently curves away behind the watch, physically attached correctly. A small real crown on the right of the case.

No other objects, no jewelry props, no rocks, no plinth. Left half naturally falls into deep softly graduated desk shadow, with room for white website headline. A single coherent physical surface without artificial compositing or overlays.
Composition/framing: 85–100mm macro photography, oblique overhead angle, watch face occupies much of the right half, purposeful diagonal strap and highlight. Enough real depth of field to keep the dial and nearest case edge sharp, gentle focus falloff only at the far strap. Deliberate asymmetry and product clarity suitable for a luxury magazine double-page spread.
Lighting/material: precise large softbox reflected across brushed metal with a single controlled hard window-light edge; realistic small crystal reflections that do NOT obscure the hands; warm burgundy/cream/steel and graphite palette. Tiny real leather pores, minute machining lines, a subtle hairline mark on the worn book edge. Retain natural micro-texture without artificial sharpening. Rich restrained tones and gentle film-grain texture. No excessive orange grading, no glowing outlines.
